limitations: One sequential real-source session per mode on a shared host, both traced; no statistical or concurrent-client benchmark.
Both sessions used the same binary; fast graph loading and resolver reuse were disabled.
Thirty complete captured MCP data comparisons are not a full raw secondary-scan differential oracle.

Only documented path substitutions, freshness/work fields, explicitly listed root-dependent resolver-config fingerprints and topology timestamps are excluded; strict pre-exclusion differences remain in the comparison.
Immediate post-write requests returned the prior revision before watcher delivery and still reported is_stale false; measured refreshes explicitly waited for min_revision above the previous index.
Memory samples every 200 ms and at returned revisions record kernel VmHWM; higher or lower retained RSS in a single run is not a memory improvement guarantee.
Both final copies match the preserved fresh source inventory, including paths, bytes and SHA-256; original Draivix was read only.
Intermediate states combine the fresh corpus with exactly two older captured file versions, not complete historical checkout states.
XXH3-128 is an in-process change fingerprint; no durable or authentication guarantee.
Coverage remains incomplete; global analysis and parsing still run in full.
Differential CI, cache combinations, watcher/error/race acceptance, multi-client load and overall Q01-Q12 acceptance remain open.
